decision.reason: Beam 4 removes only one synthetic character error overall; real improvement is entirely spacing. Rough conditions regress, an exact real clip regresses, and beam 8 has no aggregate synthetic gain. Added decoding work and unresolved live commitment behavior are not justified by these mixed gains.

provenance.runtimeProvenanceLimit: The probe did not independently store a runtime hash at capture time; the baseline runtime reference above is from the preregistered round 3 plan. The wrapper used the unchanged current production decoder and asserted exact greedy reconstruction for every clip.
provenance.frontendAndModel: Unchanged v6 weights, 150 Hz frontend, acoustic cache and reset rules. Fixed emissions were captured through a session wrapper, with each actual model reset kept as a separate segment.
provenance.inputIntegrity: Every input audio SHA-256 was verified against its manifest before inference.
provenance.dataStatus: Previously consumed recordings and synthetic fixtures used as development only; no round 3 final data accessed.
provenance.localArtifacts: .research/round3-ctc contains the probe, source report and captured emission arrays; emission arrays are not included in this archive.

method.candidateTokens: full model vocabulary at every frame
method.algorithm: CTC prefix beam with separate blank/nonblank probability sums, repeated-token stay/extension rules, merge before pruning, and common per-frame probability rescaling.
method.rendering: Collapse CTC repeats and blanks; concatenate model tokens, collapse whitespace and strip outer whitespace identically for recorded greedy reconstruction and beam output.
validation: Exact probability-sum agreement with exhaustive path enumeration for random sequences of 1–5 frames with 3 tokens.
Reconstructed greedy output equals production output for every evaluated clip.
Independent source review found no CTC recurrence blocker.
method.streamingCommitLimitation: Full-segment beam winners may revise earlier text. These are offline fixed-emission scores, not evidence for equivalent irreversible streaming output. Production use would require independently tested bounded-latency prefix commitment and bounded state.

scoring.errors: Levenshtein distance on full character strings, including spaces.
scoring.nonspaceErrors: Levenshtein distance after removing ASCII spaces from reference and hypothesis; reported only as a diagnostic, not as an alternate selection metric.
scoring.negativeFalseCharacters: Non-space output characters on empty-reference noise clips.
scoring.timing: rows.seconds.greedy is full acoustic inference plus greedy decode. Other rows.seconds entries are added prefix beam time only. Summary inferenceSeconds includes both acoustic and selected decoder time.
scoring.timingLimit: Shared-machine wall times, not a controlled speed benchmark. Beam summary inferenceSeconds adds the shared acoustic-plus-greedy time and the measured extra beam decode time.

observations: Real human v2: 16 to 14 errors out of 438 reference characters for both beam widths; all gains are spacing, and nonspace errors stay at 6.
Old Marine: 12 errors out of 37 for all variants; one restored space is offset by a newly incorrect space in a previously exact WOOH clip. Nonspace errors stay at 9.
Synthetic: 148 to 147 errors out of 1467 for beam 4 and 148 for beam 8. Rough errors increase from 17 to 18/19; chaos errors fall from 130 to 128 for both beams.
Clean, human, crowded and fading counts are unchanged. All variants emit zero false characters across 240 seconds of synthetic negative audio.
